claim: In the matching retail DLL, Referee.GetCurrentFormDispInfo (0x06005098) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 104-byte body. It first tests CurrentAnmIdx with signed bounds: CurrentAnmIdx < 0 returns null, and CurrentAnmIdx >= CurrentSkill.anmData.Length returns null. For an in-range animation index it loads CurrentSkill.anmData[CurrentAnmIdx]. It then tests currentFormIdx with signed bounds: currentFormIdx < 0 returns null, and currentFormIdx >= that animation record's formDispList.Length returns null. Only when both indices are in range does it return formDispList[currentFormIdx]. FACT-0070 pins two direct calls to this helper at UpdateRefereeAnm IL+0x00DF and IL+0x0109.
